acceptanceCriteria: work-item new exposes a start advisory when residual Work Items, branches, or worktrees exist and does not force a stop for unrelated leftovers
the advisory remains machine-readable and includes actionable next actions while existing start behavior remains compatible
focused regression tests prove the advisory is present on scaffold output and no residual resource is deleted
workflow documentation in English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese states the next action after each lifecycle step and separates completed result from cleanup status
goal: Make Work Item creation surface a read-only residual-resource advisory and make the documented lifecycle expose the next action after each stage.
intent: Prevent the repository cleanup process from silently leaving residual branches or worktrees that the next Agent never sees.
outOfScope: historical evidence and generated lifecycle receipts
